company: OpenAI (OpenAI Group PBC, formerly OpenAI Global LLC / OpenAI, Inc.)

ownership.quote: A for-profit subsidiary was created in 2019, and a 2025 restructuring converted the subsidiary into OpenAI Group PBC, that is 26% owned by the nonprofit OpenAI Foundation. Microsoft has invested over $13 billion into OpenAI.

stage.quote: In April 2026, the company announced that it closed a funding round of $122 billion in committed capital at a post-money valuation of $852 billion.
stage.note: OpenAI is a 2015-founded private company (nonprofit-controlled PBC since 2025) many rounds past series designations; it has filed for an IPO (June 2026) but is not yet public, so mapped to series-d+ as the closest enum bucket for a late-stage mega-round private company, not 'public' or 'subsidiary'.

accelerators.name: Z Fellows
accelerators.quote: listed in the Z Fellows portfolio as "OpenAI"

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of disclosed equity rounds per Wikipedia/press: Microsoft ~$1B (2019) + ~$2B (2021-22) + $10B (Jan 2023) + $6.6B (Oct 2024) + $40B (Apr 2025) + $110-122B (Feb-Apr 2026, largely overlapping/extended, counted once) ~= well over $60B; precise cumulative total not published by the company in one place, so treated as an estimate aggregated from multiple confirmed-round press reports.
total_funding_usd.quote: In February 2026, OpenAI raised $110 billion at a $730 billion valuation, led by Amazon ($50 billion), SoftBank ($30 billion), and Nvidia ($30 billion), surpassing the prior round as the largest private technology fundraise in history. The round was extended to $120 billion in March 2026.

last_round.quote: In April 2026, the company announced that it closed a funding round of $122 billion in committed capital at a post-money valuation of $852 billion.

revenue.basis: Wikipedia infobox citing CNBC (Feb 20, 2026); a separate Reuters-reported figure (Jan 19, 2026) puts annualized revenue run-rate crossing $20B in 2025, illustrating the gap between full-year revenue and ARR run-rate.

note: This card is for OpenAI's Containers / Code Interpreter / Hosted Shell / Agents API sandbox product, a feature of the OpenAI API platform, not a standalone company. OpenAI itself is one of the best-funded private companies in history: $40B round (Apr 2025, led by SoftBank) then a $110B round (Feb 2026, led by Amazon/SoftBank/Nvidia) extended to $120B (Mar 2026) and further to $122B committed at an $852B post-money valuation (Apr 2026); FT reported investor scrutiny of that $852B mark shortly after. OpenAI filed for an IPO with the SEC in June 2026 but Altman said in September 2026 the IPO is delayed to 2027, so it remains private (stage left as series-d+, not public). Ownership: nonprofit OpenAI Foundation holds 26%, Microsoft holds 27%, employees/other investors hold 47%; Microsoft is a major strategic investor/partner (not a parent) and has a 20%-of-revenue-until-AGI arrangement that was later loosened (Apr 2026). The company reports large ongoing operating losses (~$9B net loss, 2025 est.) alongside rapid revenue growth.
